ost-b.cost),signature=available.map(u=>u.key).join(',');const grid=$('clickerUpgrades');if(grid.dataset.signature!==signature){grid.dataset.signature=signature;grid.innerHTML=available.length?available.map(u=>`<button class="clickerUpgrade" data-upgrade="${u.key}"><b>${u.name}</b><small>${u.id===-2?(u.tier===2?'Golden effects last twice as long':'Golden Ty appears twice as often and stays twice as long'):u.id===-1?'+1% of automatic production per click':u.id===0?(u.tier<3?'Double click and Clicker output':u.tier===3?'+0.1 to clicking and Clickers per non-Clicker':`Multiply the per-building click bonus by ${fingerMult[u.tier]}`):'Double '+buildings[u.id].name+' production'}</small><span>${fmt(u.cost)} beats</span></button>`).join(''):'<p class="muted">Buy buildings and keep clicking to unlock upgrades.</p>'}grid.querySelectorAll('[data-upgrade]').forEach(b=>b.disabled=state.balance<upgrades.find(u=>u.key===b.dataset.upgrade).cost);dirty=false}

async function checkTyGift(active){
 if(!active){giftChecked=false;return}
 const uid=currentUser?.id||null;if(uid!==giftUser){giftUser=uid;giftChecked=false;giftRetryAt=0}
 if(!uid||giftChecked||giftBusy||goldenLife>0||Date.now()<giftRetryAt)return;
 giftBusy=true;
 try{const {data,error}=await supa.rpc('claim_admin_golden_ty');if(currentUser?.id!==uid)return;if(error){giftRetryAt=Date.now()+15000;return}giftChecked=true;if(data){showGolden();$('goldenTyNotice').textContent='An admin sent you a Golden Ty! Tap him before he disappears.'}}catch{giftRetryAt=Date.now()+15000}finally{giftBusy=false}
}
function showGolden(){goldenAge=0;goldenLife=13*2**[0,1].filter(t=>has('gold:'+t)).length;const button=$('goldenTy');button.style.left=(8+Math.random()*65)+'%';button.style.top=(8+Math.random()*50)+'%';button.hidden=false;$('goldenTyNotice').textContent='Golden Ty appeared! Tap him before he disappears.';dirty=true}
function grantGolden(){if(goldenLife<=0||$('goldenTy').hidden)return;goldenLife=0;$('goldenTy').hidden=true;state.goldenClicks++;const choices=['frenzy','lucky'];if(Math.random()<.1)choices.push('click');if(state.owned.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)>=10&&Math.random()<.25)choices.push('building');if(lastGoldenEffect&&Math.random()<.8){const index=choices.indexOf(lastGoldenEffect);if(index>=0)choices.splice(index,1)}let effect=choices[Math.floor(Math.random()*choices.length)];const duration=has('gold:2')?2:1;let label='';
function buff(key,type,mult,seconds,text){const old=buffs.find(b=>b.key===key);if(old)old.remaining+=seconds*duration;else buffs.push({key,type,mult,remaining:seconds*duration,label:text});label=text}
if(effect==='building'){const eligible=buildings.filter(b=>state.owned[b.id]>=10);if(!eligible.length)effect='frenzy';else{const building=eligible[Math.floor(Math.random()*eligible.length)];buff('building:'+building.id,'production',1+state.owned[building.id]/10,30,building.name+' special ×'+(1+state.owned[building.id]/10))}}
if(effect==='frenzy')buff('frenzy','production',7,77,'Ty Frenzy ×7');else if(effect==='click')buff('click','click',777,13,'Ty Click Frenzy ×777');else if(effect==='lucky'){const amount=Math.min(state.balance*.15,cps()*900)+13;earn(amount);label='Lucky Ty! +'+fmt(amount)+' beats'}lastGoldenEffect=effect;$('goldenTyNotice').textContent=label;dirty=true;render();save()}
$('goldenTy').onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();loadUser();grantGolden()};
function advance(seconds,active){let remaining=seconds;while(remaining>0){const boundary=buffs.length?Math.min(...buffs.map(b=>b.remaining)):remaining;const slice=Math.min(remaining,Math.max(.001,boundary));earn(cps()*slice);buffs.forEach(b=>b.remaining-=slice);buffs=buffs.filter(b=>b.remaining>0);remaining-=slice}if(!active)return;if(goldenLife>0){goldenLife-=seconds;if(goldenLife<=0){goldenLife=0;$('goldenTy').hidden=true;$('goldenTyNotice').textContent='Golden Ty disappeared. Another will appear later.'}return}goldenStep+=seconds;const factor=2**[0,1].filter(t=>has('gold:'+t)).length,min=300/factor,max=900/factor;while(goldenStep>=1/30){goldenStep-=1/30;goldenAge+=1/30;if(goldenAge>=min&&Math.random()<Math.min(1,((goldenAge-min)/(max-min))**5)){showGolden();goldenStep=0;break}}}
setInterval(()=>{if(!window.yeArcadeSync.ready()){last=performance.now();return}loadUser();const now=performance.now(),seconds=Math.max(0,(now-last)/1000);last=now;const active=!document.hidden&&!$('clickerGame').hidden&&document.getElementById('gamesScreen').classList.contains('activeScreen');checkTyGift(active);advance(seconds,active);if(active&&(dirty||buffs.length))render()},100);setInterval(()=>{if(window.yeArcadeSync.ready())save()},5000);window.addEventListener('pagehide',save);loadUser();render();

Import a valid backup to recover it.'}buffs=[];goldenAge=goldenLife=goldenStep=0;last=performance.now();dirty=true;render()});
window.yeClicker={buildings,upgrades,quote,cps,clickValue,purchase,buyUpgrade,getState:()=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state))};
})();

'use strict';
class RunnerModel {
 constructor(random=Math.random){this.random=random;this.reset()}
 reset(){this.x=110;this.y=0;this.vy=0;this.distance=0;this.cleared=0;this.speed=300;this.obstacles=[];this.wait=1.8;this.alive=true;this.jumpBuffer=0}
 jump(){this.jumpBuffer=.12;if(this.y===0&&this.vy===0){this.vy=570;this.jumpBuffer=0;return true}return false}
 step(dt){if(!this.alive)return;this.jumpBuffer=Math.max(0,this.jumpBuffer-dt);if(this.y===0&&this.jumpBuffer>0){this.vy=570;this.jumpBuffer=0}this.y+=this.vy*dt;this.vy-=1500*dt;if(this.y<=0){this.y=0;this.vy=0}this.distance+=this.speed*dt;this.speed=Math.min(620,300+this.distance/450);this.wait-=dt;if(this.wait<=0){const count=this.distance>1800&&this.random()<.3?2:1;this.obstacles.push({x:950,w:count*36+(count-1)*8,h:72+this.random()*14,count});this.wait=.95+this.random()*.6}for(const o of this.obstacles)o.x-=this.speed*dt;this.obstacles=this.obstacles.filter(o=>o.x+o.w>-50);const player={left:this.x+7,right:this.x+37,bottom:this.y+6,top:this.y+67};for(const o of this.obstacles){if(player.right>o.x+4&&player.left<o.x+o.w-4&&player.bottom<o.h-3&&player.top>0){this.alive=false;break}}if(this.alive)for(const o of this.obstacles){o.passed=o.passed||0;while(o.passed<o.count&&o.x+o.passed*44+36-4<=player.left){o.passed++;this.cleared++}}}
 get score(){return Math.floor(this.distance/10)}
}
